components.name: Open circular arrow
components.description: An incomplete circular outline has a diagonal arrow extending from its upper right side. Exclude the two detached circles and triangle; preserve the lower-left opening pending confirmation.

components.name: Unequal circle pair
components.description: Two separate plain circles sit diagonally beside each other, the right circle slightly higher and larger. Exclude the circular arrow and triangle.

components.name: Upright outline triangle
components.description: An upright triangle has two equal sloping sides and a horizontal base. Exclude the circular arrow and detached circle pair.
